name: "Resolve Demo API artifact resources"
description: "Resolve Demo API ECR and release artifact resources without deploy dependencies."

inputs:
  deploy_env:
    description: "Deployment environment: dev or prod."
    required: true
  aws_region:
    description: "AWS region."
    required: false
    default: "us-east-1"
  ecr_repository_override:
    description: "Optional ECR repository name override, used after shared artifact ECR is bootstrapped."
    required: false
    default: ""
  release_artifacts_bucket_override:
    description: "Optional release artifacts bucket name override."
    required: false
    default: ""

outputs:
  account_id:
    description: "AWS account ID."
    value: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.account_id }}
  ecr_registry:
    description: "ECR registry hostname."
    value: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.ecr_registry }}
  ecr_repository:
    description: "ECR repository name."
    value: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.ecr_repository }}
  ecr_repository_url:
    description: "Full ECR repository URL."
    value: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.ecr_repository_url }}
  release_artifacts_bucket:
    description: "Release artifacts S3 bucket."
    value: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.release_artifacts_bucket }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - id: resolve
      shell: bash
      env:
        DEPLOY_ENV: ${{ inputs.deploy_env }}
        AWS_REGION_INPUT: ${{ inputs.aws_region }}
        ECR_REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE: ${{ inputs.ecr_repository_override }}
        RELEASE_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET_OVERRIDE: ${{ inputs.release_artifacts_bucket_override }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        case "$DEPLOY_ENV" in
          dev|prod) ;;
          *)
            echo "::error::Unsupported deploy_env=$DEPLOY_ENV"
            exit 1
            ;;
        esac

        aws_region="${AWS_REGION_INPUT:-${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}}"
        account_id="${ACCOUNT_ID:-}"
        if [ -z "$account_id" ]; then
          account_id="$(aws sts get-caller-identity \
            --query Account \
            --output text \
            --region "$aws_region")"
        fi

        if ! [[ "$account_id" =~ ^[0-9]{12}$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Unable to resolve a valid AWS account ID."
          exit 1
        fi

        if [ -n "$ECR_REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE" ]; then
          ecr_repository="$ECR_REPOSITORY_OVERRIDE"
        else
          # Transition default: keep the existing working dev ECR path until
          # the shared artifact repository is bootstrapped and selected via
          # DEMO_API_ARTIFACT_ECR_REPOSITORY.
          ecr_repository="demo-${DEPLOY_ENV}-shared-demo-ms"
        fi

        if ! [[ "$ecr_repository" =~ ^[a-z0-9]+([._/-][a-z0-9]+)*$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::ECR repository name is invalid."
          exit 1
        fi

        if [ -n "$RELEASE_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET_OVERRIDE" ]; then
          release_artifacts_bucket="$RELEASE_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET_OVERRIDE"
        else
          release_artifacts_bucket="demo-release-artifacts-${account_id}"
        fi

        if ! [[ "$release_artifacts_bucket" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Release artifacts bucket name is invalid."
          exit 1
        fi

        ecr_registry="${account_id}.dkr.ecr.${aws_region}.amazonaws.com"
        ecr_repository_url="${ecr_registry}/${ecr_repository}"

        echo "::add-mask::$account_id"
        echo "::add-mask::$release_artifacts_bucket"

        {
          echo "AWS_REGION=$aws_region"
          echo "ACCOUNT_ID=$account_id"
          echo "ECR_REGISTRY=$ecr_registry"
          echo "ECR_REPOSITORY=$ecr_repository"
          echo "ECR_REPOSITORY_URL=$ecr_repository_url"
          echo "RELEASE_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET=$release_artifacts_bucket"
        } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        {
          echo "account_id=$account_id"
          echo "ecr_registry=$ecr_registry"
          echo "ecr_repository=$ecr_repository"
          echo "ecr_repository_url=$ecr_repository_url"
          echo "release_artifacts_bucket=$release_artifacts_bucket"
        } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        echo "Resolved Demo API artifact resources for deploy_env=${DEPLOY_ENV}."
